scope: Dedicated official Android TV API28/x86 software emulator environment

issues.observed: Default emulator rewrote data partition to 6 GiB and demanded 7372.80 MB before userdata creation; explicit partition-size 2048 did not change that gate.
issues.action: Use an independent tmpfs data image after checking available memory and filesystem capacity. Retain data and encryption key with their overlays; archive them after shutdown.

issues.observed: First-stage init repeatedly failed mounting PCI06.0/by-name/vendor and rebooted to bootloader. Kernel identified vendor GPT as vde1; QEMU monitor proved vendor at PCI07.0 and encryption drive at06.0.
issues.cause: Emulator AVD discovery checks contentDir/encryptionkey.img for vendor PCI slot calculation; automatic encryption key creation follows the -data directory. External tmpfs data directory split those paths. x86 uses ACPI; no default.dtb file or -dtb parameter was present.
issues.action: Stop emulator; copy the same raw encryption key into the AVD discovery directory and verify identical SHA-256. Keep actual key and overlay at original tmpfs path using explicit -encryption-key. Cold-start with all official image bytes and CPU unchanged.
issues.verifiedAfterAction: Vendor mount succeeded; init advanced to surfaceflinger/bootanim and adb state became device. System boot completion and JS results are recorded separately.

issues.observed: After mount repair, initial system package setup spent software-emulation time in TVLauncher first-boot dex2oat quicken. Crash log buffer was empty.
issues.action: Dedicated development AVD only: change pm.dexopt.first-boot from quicken and pm.dexopt.install from speed-profile to extract for subsequent package preparation. Let active system compilation finish. Do not prewarm JS or change product execution timeout.
issues.restore: Non-persistent properties reset on cold boot; may restore quicken/speed-profile with setprop.

bootReadback.timingScope: Time spent in the final boot polling command; not total cold-start duration or a television performance measurement
